claims.source_quote_ar: ما ألف عليه من النظم المعجز الفائت لقوى البشر.

claims.claim_en: Emphasis on the inimitability (i'jaz) of the Qur'an — highlighting the miraculous, inimitable composition that surpasses human capacity.

claims.claim_ar: وجود طباق (تضاد) بين مُسمَّى الحقيقة «الْحَقُّ» وبين حال أكثر الناس «لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ» — أي إيجاب الحق مقابل سلب الإيمان.
claims.claim_en: Presence of antithesis (tibaq) between the affirmed Truth ('al- haqq') and the negated state of most people ('they do not believe') — affirmation vs. negation contrast.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited phrase names the rhetorical figure generally; confirm the commentator was referring specifically to this ayah's polarity (affirmation vs. negation) rather than a different lexical example in the chunk.
